study: Round 4: volume and spread signals on free delayed (historical) SIP data

data.sip_bars: Alpaca historical SIP 1m bars (free: request end > 15 min in the past; verified 13:25 ET 2026-09-26: SIP 9/25 and 2025-10-01 bars returned, end=now-5min refused 'subscription does not permit querying recent SIP data')
data.iex_bars: existing IEX 1m caches (edge_iex_bars/liq for L, edge_iex_bars/DAY.pkl for C) + 20 warm-up days fetched the same way
data.sip_quotes: S1 only: SIP NBBO, last quote in (t-1s, t] at each minute boundary t, 09:45..15:50
data.outcome_prices: always SIP 1m closes (forward-filled), whichever feed detected the signal
data.warmup: 20 trading days before each universe's first day (for same-time-of-day 20-day volume averages)

C.names: Claude's Stage B universe: each day's symbols in combined_stage_b_rows.pkl (top $20-100 names by prior-day dollar volume, ~250/day, 327 unique)

common.decision: at the close of 1m bar k (k = minutes after 09:30 of bar start); decisions only at or after 09:45 (k >= 14)
common.entry: V signals: SIP close of the signal bar (= next bar's open). S1: SIP close one minute after the snapshot ('entry next minute')
common.hold_rule: fixed holds need exit bar <= 15:50; 'to 15:50' needs >= 15 min left
common.cost: full modeled quoted spread at entry per round trip, bp
common.refractory: one signal per name per signal variant per 15 min
common.direction: long is the tested side; short mirror reported as info only
common.stats: per-trade mean net bp; t = day-clustered (mean of day means / SE); 95% CI day bootstrap

V1_pace.def: pace = cumulative RTH volume through bar k / mean over the prior 20 trading days (>=15 present) of that name's cumulative volume through bar k; evaluated on the 15-min grid 09:45,10:00,...,15:30
V1_pace.long: pace >= X AND close > session VWAP AND close > prior RTH close
V1_pace.short_info: pace >= X AND close < VWAP AND close < prior close
V1_pace.claude_reference: rvol_pace = SIP volume so far / (20d avg daily SIP volume x expected fraction); runway_target_study pace>=1.64: runway 4.0%->16.0% (z +13.8); vol_trail_book S7 (one arm + pace>=1.64) +0.046%/trade t~0.9

V2_breakout.def: bar volume (1m, or 5m aligned to 09:30) >= k x mean of the prior 20 bars of that timeframe (previous session's RTH bars fill in early); close > max high of the prior N minutes before the bar
V2_breakout.short_info: same volume test, close < min low of prior N minutes
V2_breakout.claude_reference: wr_trigger_study vol_brk = 1m volume > 3x 20-min mean and close > prior 15-min high: SIP runway 1.22x, fwd15 +9.4 bp gross (t 3.1), halves +3/+12; on IEX detection fwd15 +2.0 (t 0.6), halves -10/+9

V3_vsa.def: 1m bars; avg range and avg volume = mean of the prior 20 bars
V3_vsa.EFR_long: up bar (C>O), range >= 1.5x avg range, volume >= 2x avg volume, (C-L)/(H-L) >= 0.75
V3_vsa.ABS_long: volume >= 2x avg, range <= 0.75x avg range, after a 15-min decline (C[k-1] < C[k-16])
V3_vsa.NS_long: uptrend (C[k-1] > C[k-31] and C[k] > VWAP), down bar (C<O), volume <= 0.5x avg, range <= 1.0x avg
V3_vsa.short_info: mirrors (down EFR closing in bottom quarter; ABS after a 15-min rise; up-bar no-demand in a downtrend)

S1_quotes.universe: L only, first 30 names of edge_fetch.LIQUID (SPY QQQ IWM DIA SMH XLF XLE XLK TLT GLD AAPL MSFT NVDA AMZN GOOGL META TSLA AVGO JPM V MA UNH XOM LLY JNJ PG HD COST ABBV MRK)
S1_quotes.days: tune[::6] (25), validate[::3] (17), holdout[::3] (17) = 59 days x 366 snapshots (request budget ~6 h at 1 req/s)
S1_quotes.S1a_narrow_long: spread_now <= 0.67 x median of the previous 30 snapshots (>= 20 present); long (non-directional: short mirror = sign flip)

signals.iex_side_by_side: V1, V2 (and V3) are detected on SIP bars and separately on IEX bars; outcomes always on SIP prices, same spread

baselines.random_across_days: for each signal, 5 draws: same name, same clock hour, random minute, random other day within the same split part; excess = net - mean(draw nets); day-clustered t on excess
baselines.same_day: same name, same day, random minute in the same clock hour (look-ahead caveat: shares the day's drift/news)

promotion.L: long only: net > 0 on tune AND validate, day-clustered t >= 2 on tune+validate pooled, and excess vs random_across_days > 0 on tune+validate pooled; holdout printed once, only for promoted cells (at most 5, by pooled t)
promotion.C: long only: net > 0 and t >= 2 and excess > 0 on the 40 tune days; the 20 holdout days printed once, only for promoted cells (at most 5)
promotion.multiple_testing: ~300 long cells (L: 14 signal variants x 5 holds x 2 feeds = 140; C: 140; S1: 3 x 5 = 15), heavily correlated; with a one-sided 2.3% false-positive rate per cell, several spurious promotions are expected. A promotion that fails holdout counts as noise.
